stemMarkdown: The average weight of 12 students increases by 2 kg when a new student replaces one weighing 32 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new student?
solutionMarkdown: The total weight rises by $12 \times 2 = 24$ kg. That entire increase comes from one swap, so the new student is $24$ kg heavier than the one who left: $32 + 24 = 56$ kg.
